notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first succeeded throughout via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome110). robots.txt checked first: no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, only bot-specific and path-specific disallows (cart/checkout/account/etc) that do not cover any category URL used here; Playwright/tier(b) was used only for initial exploration of the client-hydrated menu text (confirmed HTML from plain curl_cffi already contains the same breadcrumb count and product list markup server-side, so all final qty/tree data was re-verified via plain HTTP fetch, not JS execution). Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome not needed. TREE: built from union of (1) the live mega-menu nav for Soft Furnishings, Rugs, Decor, Kitchen, Beds, Kids, Furniture (crawled via anchor extraction, title="Shop X" href=... pattern, and c-subCatCarousel chips), and (2) sitemaps/collections.xml.gz (926 unique collection URLs). Every candidate leaf's H1 and breadcrumb '(N items)' count (present server-side in <span class="c-crumb__count">) was fetched individually to confirm it renders its own node (not a silently-inherited parent/sibling number) before being recorded. QTY: taken verbatim from each page's own breadcrumb '(N items)' count. EXCLUDED and why: (1) /storage (467 items, breadcrumb 'Home > Furniture > Storage') and all its children (TV Consoles, Sideboards, Bookshelves, Display Cabinets, Shoe Racks & Cabinets, Wardrobes, Chest of Drawers, Wall Shelves, Clothes Racks, Office Cabinets) - confirmed every child's real URL is under /furniture-all/*, i.e. genuine Furniture per storage.md Sec21, out of scope for this task (Furniture already extracted separately). (2) /decor/trays-baskets and its children decorative-baskets/decorative-trays - site's own copy calls them 'Decorative trays and baskets', matches storage.md Sec23/24 decorative-only exclusion. (3) /decor/bathroom-accessories (84 items) - inspected product list: predominantly soap pumps, toothbrush holders, mirrors, toilet brush (general bathroom accessories), only incidentally 1-2 storage-type items (shower caddy, corner bin) mixed in with no separable URL - not a genuine storage category. (4) /decor/wall-hooks-holders, /decor/tissue-boxes, /decor/trash-bins-1, /decor/automated-laundry-racks (electric drying rack, not containment/storage), /decor/ironing-boards - none are storage per rules. (5) /soft-furnishings/curtains-curtain-rods (11 items) - inspected full product list: 100% curtain rods + room dividers, zero actual fabric curtain panels, so excluded per textile.md Sec5 hardware exclusion (evidence-checked, not assumed). (6) /soft-furnishings/pillows-bolsters-1 (68 items) - inspected: memory foam / latex / orthopedic sleep pillows (health/support products), not textile/fabric goods. (7) /kitchen/table-linen-coasters (58 items) - inspected: majority rattan/wood/acrylic/silicone coasters (non-textile), fabric placemats a minority with no separate URL - excluded as mixed/non-primary-textile. (8) /kitchen/dish-racks - drying function, not storage/containment. (9) /kids/kids-mats-rugs (12 items) - inspected: all foam/vinyl 'splat mats' and play mats, not fabric rugs. (10) /kids/baby-cots-beddings (81 items) - mixed cot furniture + bedding textile with no URL split; the clean textile-only subset is separately captured via /baby-pillows-beddings. (11) /kids/toy-storage-play-mats and /kids/kids-bookshelves-storage - inspected: predominantly kids shelving/wardrobe/cabinet furniture (both live under the 'Kids Furniture' nav node), excluded as Furniture boundary. (12) /entryway-organisers (61 items, sitemap-only) - inspected: mirror cabinets, umbrella stands, coat racks - entryway furniture/decor, not genuine storage containers. (13) Brand/marketing collection pages found only in the sitemap (aykasa-foldable-organizers, bedding-essentials-by-hipvan, heveya-natural-organic-bedding, mika-modular-storage-by-hipvan, mad-about-mats, llama-rugs-by-hipvan, qq-mats, toddlekind-prettier-playmats, table-matters, storage-boxes-old, hv-atelier/hv-basic/hv-modern-* collections, drinkware-food-storage (mixed with non-storage drinkware), reusable-food-containers (verified duplicate of /kitchen/food-storage-organising, identical H1 and count 92)) - excluded as promotional/brand collections or confirmed duplicates, not genuine taxonomy nodes. (14) /beds/king-size-beddings and sibling /beds/* bedding URLs - confirmed duplicates of the /soft-furnishings/* equivalents (identical H1 + identical item count), kept only the /soft-furnishings/ canonical path per duplicate-prevention rule. Two sitemap-only pages (/study-storage, /baby-pillows-beddings) were included as standalone leaves (not nested under a confirmed live-nav parent) because their content was individually verified as clean/genuine and their counts render correctly; flagged accordingly. Rug 'size' pages (3m x 2m / 2.4m x 1.7m / 1.7m x 1.2m Rugs) and /rugs/floor-mats-door-mats/door-mats + /floor-mats-door-mats/floor-mats were checked for the sitemap 'bad slug silently serves parent number' trap: the two /floor-mats-door-mats/* child slugs both canonicalize back to the parent (same H1, same count, same canonical URL) so only the parent 'Floor Mats & Door Mats' was recorded; the three size-segmented rug pages returned distinct H1s/distinct counts so were kept as genuine sibling categories (same pattern already used for King/Queen/Single Size Beddings).
